items.reason: The invalid-zone failure already exists upstream: packages/core/getUserAvailability.ts:210 passes the same timezone to getWorkingHours, whose unchanged conversion at packages/lib/availability.ts:74 throws before checkIfIsAvailable runs. Nonempty dateOverrides require nonempty availability (packages/core/getUserAvailability.ts:215), so the earlier conversion cannot be skipped in the reported scenario; this PR introduces no new failure for invalid zones.
